heroTitle.en: An agent-native 3D stage for reproducible production.
heroTitle.zh: 面向可复现制作的 Agent 原生 3D 片场。

heroLead.en: Director connects interactive staging, cameras, animation timelines, and verified agent operations through one inspectable project state.
heroLead.zh: Director 将交互式搭景、相机、动画时间线与可验证的 Agent 操作连接到同一份可检查的项目状态中。

claimOne.en: Every evaluation claim should point to a scene revision, an operation trace, and a reproducible capture.
claimOne.zh: 每项评测结论都应对应场景版本、操作轨迹与可复现的画面证据。

abstractTitle.en: A common state for artists, tools, and agents.
abstractTitle.zh: 让创作者、工具与 Agent 共享同一状态。

abstractBody.en: Director is a browser-based 3D production workbench. Its editor and its MCP, HTTP, and CLI interfaces operate on the same validated project representation, so a shot can be authored, audited, replayed, and inspected without coordinate-clicking assumptions.
abstractBody.zh: Director 是一个浏览器端 3D 制作工作台。编辑器及其 MCP、HTTP 和 CLI 接口操作同一份经过校验的项目表示，因此一个镜头可以在不依赖坐标点击假设的情况下被创作、审计、重放和检查。

systemTitle.zh: 一个项目，四个控制界面。

systemBody.en: Human interaction remains first-class, while coding agents can use structured tools with the same state transitions and validation boundaries.
systemBody.zh: 人工交互仍是第一等能力；同时，编程 Agent 可通过结构化工具使用相同的状态迁移与校验边界。

evaluationBody.en: The current release publishes an evaluation protocol rather than a ranked leaderboard. It specifies what can be observed, validated, replayed, and captured for each task family.
evaluationBody.zh: 当前版本发布的是评测协议，而非排名榜单。它规定了每类任务可被观察、校验、重放和捕获的证据。

reproducibilityBody.en: The source tree includes tests, schema validation, build checks, and a local gateway. The documentation records the exact commands and artifacts expected from a reproducible run.
reproducibilityBody.zh: 源代码包含测试、Schema 校验、构建检查与本地网关。文档记录可复现实验应使用的准确命令与产物。

paperTitle.en: From a scene specification to reviewable evidence.
paperTitle.zh: 从场景规范到可审查证据。

limitations.en: This website does not report fabricated benchmark scores. Formal task sets, evaluator identities, statistical methodology, and public result tables remain to be released with a versioned protocol.
limitations.zh: 本网站不报告虚构的基准成绩。正式任务集、评测者信息、统计方法和公开结果表将在带版本号的协议中发布。

source.en: This portal uses Director’s own code, typography, diagrams, and project-specific text.
source.zh: 本门户使用 Director 自己的代码、字体、图表和项目文本。

footer.zh: Director Research · Agent 原生 3D 制作工作台

description.en: Versioned objects, groups, cameras, and environment settings define the visible stage.
description.zh: 带版本的对象、分组、相机与环境设定定义可见片场。

description.en: Lens, aspect, pose, target, and camera action are explicit parameters rather than implicit viewport state.
description.zh: 焦距、画幅、位姿、目标与镜头动作均为明确参数，而非隐式视口状态。

description.en: Frame-native tracks, keyframes, paths, and clips describe motion as reviewable timeline data.
description.zh: 以帧为原生单位的轨道、关键帧、路径和片段把运动描述为可审查的时间线数据。

description.en: Structured authoring, audit, correction, and capture operations produce an inspectable execution trail.
description.zh: 结构化的创作、审计、修正与捕获操作形成可检查的执行轨迹。

detail.en: Read a compact scene or project view before changing state.
detail.zh: 在修改状态前读取紧凑的场景或项目视图。

detail.en: Apply a validated, atomic batch of structured actions.
detail.zh: 应用一批经校验且原子化的结构化动作。

detail.en: Check structural, spatial, temporal, and camera-space conditions.
detail.zh: 检查结构、空间、时间与相机空间条件。

detail.en: Export a revision-bound frame and trace for review or downstream use.
detail.zh: 导出与版本绑定的画面和轨迹，供审查或下游使用。

body.en: This documentation describes the implementation as it exists in this repository. It separates verified system behavior from future benchmark claims, so external users can reproduce what is actually available today.
body.zh: 本文档描述本仓库中实际存在的实现。它将已验证的系统行为与未来基准结论分开，便于外部使用者复现今天真实可用的能力。

body.en: Install dependencies, start the UI and gateway, then run the test and production-build checks. Treat the command output as the first reproducibility artifact.
body.zh: 安装依赖，启动 UI 与网关，然后运行测试和生产构建检查。命令输出应被视为第一份可复现性产物。

body.en: A task should begin with an observed baseline, execute only declared operations, pass validation, record an audit, and finish with a capture or portable project artifact.
body.zh: 一个任务应从已观察的基线开始，只执行已声明的操作，通过校验，记录审计，并以捕获画面或可移植项目产物结束。

title.en: One state across UI and agents
title.zh: UI 与 Agent 共享的状态

body.en: The editor, MCP server, HTTP gateway, CLI, and browser bridge are control surfaces over project data. The stable contract is the validated data and recorded result, not a coordinate-based interaction script.
body.zh: 编辑器、MCP 服务、HTTP 网关、CLI 与浏览器桥接均是项目数据的控制界面。稳定契约是已校验的数据与记录结果，而不是基于坐标的交互脚本。

title.en: What this release does not claim

body.en: This release does not claim a peer-reviewed benchmark, cross-model rankings, human preference scores, or generalization results. Those claims require a frozen task set, evaluator protocol, sampled traces, and versioned reporting.
body.zh: 本版本不宣称已完成同行评审基准、跨模型排名、人类偏好评分或泛化结果。这些结论需要冻结的任务集、评测者协议、抽样轨迹和带版本的报告。
